title: Verify: Blank and whitespace-only submit shows the inline message unit tests
summary: Unit tests for the blank branch with the API client mocked
description: Prove with mocked client that blank text shows the alert and never calls submitContribution.
acceptance_criteria: Empty submit shows alert and no API call
Whitespace-only submit shows alert and no API call
technical_constraints: vi.mock('../src/api/client') with importActual to keep ApiError and MAX_PER_PLAYER; no network

steps.action: Create the file; vi.mock '../src/api/client' spreading importActual and replacing submitContribution and listMine with vi.fn. listMine resolves with the list from the fixture in game/frontend/tests/fixtures/api.ts (contributionFixture), which mirrors the Contribution type returned by listMine in game/frontend/src/api/client.ts; do not inline the payload. Render <ContributionSheet open onClose={vi.fn()} roundId="ROUND-0000001" /> and call cleanup in afterEach.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionBlank.test.tsx
steps.expected: File loads with mocks in place.

steps.symbol: it: empty text shows 'Enter an idea first' and does not submit
steps.action: Add test: click the 'Send' button with the textarea empty; assert screen.getByRole('alert') has text 'Enter an idea first' and submitContribution toHaveBeenCalledTimes(0).
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionBlank.test.tsx -t "empty text"

steps.symbol: it: whitespace-only text shows the message and does not submit
steps.action: Add test: fireEvent.change the textarea (label 'Your idea') to '   \n  ', click Send; assert the alert text 'Enter an idea first' and submitContribution not called.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionBlank.test.tsx -t "whitespace-only"

steps.symbol: it: textarea is marked invalid and described by the alert
steps.action: Add test: after blank Send assert the textarea has attribute aria-invalid='true' and aria-describedby equal to the alert element id.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionBlank.test.tsx -t "marked invalid"
